# RustSheet eval baseline (known failures). Generated by `rustsheet-eval update-baseline`;
# never edit by hand. `C<TAB>case<TAB>checked-cells` lists every case; `F<TAB>case<TAB>item` lists
# known failures. Removing an F line = a fix. Adding an F line to an unchanged case = a regression
# and requires --allow-regressions plus a justification in the PR (docs/process/quality-gates.md).
